messages:
arjun: Uploading pen-test + vuln-scan artifacts for the Spark Health POC now. Need: S3 bundle link, sha256 checksums, and a proposed remediation timeline to share with their security team. Can we get redaction confirmation too?

maria_sec: Which reports are included? full PT report, Nessus/Qualys export, and container SBOMs? We need to strip customer IPs and any PHI before handing over. Also confirm whether they requested raw findings or a sanitized evidence bundle.

pat_ops: Creating bundle now. Will include: pt-report.pdf (redacted), qualys-export.csv, sbom.json, remediation_owner_map.csv, and a redaction_manifest.txt. Upload started to s3://redwood-vendor-evidence/spark-health/1998643210/

pat_ops: deploy-bot:upload -> started

arjun: For the timeline: Spark asked for ETA on fixes for critical/high findings and a tentative cadence for medium. Suggested: critical = 72h response + mitigation plan, high = 7 days, medium = tracked in next sprint (2 weeks). Is that doable?

maria_sec: 72h for critical seems reasonable for a POC-grade SLA but depends on owner availability. I'll flag true-critical (RCE/credentials exposure) vs critical (auth bypass). We'll include a severity mapping in the manifest.

pat_ops: upload-bot: upload complete -> s3://redwood-vendor-evidence/spark-health/1998643210/pt-artifacts-1998643210.zip (encrypted, KMS key: aws/redwood-ops). Checksums: sha256: 8f3a9b0c2d... (full checksum in bucket).

pat_ops: To verify locally:```\naws s3 cp s3://redwood-vendor-evidence/spark-health/1998643210/pt-artifacts-1998643210.zip .\nsha256sum pt-artifacts-1998643210.zip\n```

maria_sec: Important: we added redaction_manifest.txt listing all removed IPs/hosts and 'redaction_method=mask'. Also attached redaction scripts and a short QA checklist (redaction_qc.md). Please do NOT include stack traces with customer IDs.

arjun: Great. Can you export a CSV mapping each vuln id -> component -> owner -> proposed fix ETA? Spark's risk team requested that specifically.

pat_ops: Done. remediation_owner_map.csv uploaded. Owner groups: eng-runtime, eng-platform, infra-sre. I mapped obvious owners; owners should confirm.

sam_sales: Quick ask: include a 1-page executive summary for the customer (one PDF) that explains scope, what we redacted, and the proposed cadence. Legal will need it for the contract.

maria_sec: I'll draft the exec summary and include the severity buckets + our remediation SLAs. Will tag owners to confirm each ETA.

arjun: I'll send the S3 link + checksum and the exec summary to Spark Sec once owners confirm ETAs. Proposed send window: today EOD PST.

pat_ops: Noted. Also added cross-account read role for their vendor-reviewer IAM (role: arn:aws:iam::SPARK:role/VendorEvidenceReadOnly) with 7-day expiry. Added permissions log to the bucket.

maria_sec: We should schedule a 30-min triage call with Spark Sec to walk findings. I'm available Tue 10am PT or Wed 2pm PT. Which works?

arjun: I'll propose Tue 10am PT. If they accept, we can present criticals and agree on immediate mitigations.

pat_ops: Last note: retention policy - artifacts will be kept for 30 days in the evidence bucket then moved to Glacier. If Spark needs longer retention we can extend.

upload-bot: artifact_access_log: {"path":"s3://redwood-vendor-evidence/spark-health/1998643210/","uploaded_by":"pat_ops","size":"42MB","sha256":"8f3a9b0c2d9e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9"}

arjun: Final action items: (1) owners confirm ETAs in remediation_owner_map.csv by EOD, (2) maria_sec to finish exec summary, (3) I will send link+checksum to Spark + propose Tue 10am PT. Thanks all.

pat_ops: Acknowledged.

maria_sec: Acknowledged, will update exec summary and tag owners.

upload-bot: thread closed for edits at 1998644325
